name: Reverse Strategy
summary: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy that trades against the prevailing trend when price reaches extreme levels. It identifies overbought and oversold conditions using technical indicators and opens counter-trend positions expecting a reversal. The strategy includes built-in stop loss and take profit levels for each trade.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一种均值回归策略，当价格达到极端水平时逆势交易。它利用技术指标识别超买和超卖状态，并开仓反向头寸以期价格回归均值。每笔交易都设有止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是均值回归，即在价格偏离均值达到一定程度时进行反向交易。入场条件基于技术指标识别超买或超卖状态，当指标达到极端值时触发入场信号。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈，也可能在指标回归中性区域时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA设置了每笔交易的最大风险比例，并可能包含最大持仓限制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但均值回归策略在强趋势行情中可能面临连续亏损的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is mean reversion, trading against price extremes expecting a return to the mean. Entry conditions are triggered when technical indicators reach overbought or oversold thresholds, signaling potential reversal points. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and may also close positions when indicators return to neutral zones. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-based calculation relative to account equity. Money management incorporates a maximum risk per trade ratio and may include limits on total open positions. While the logic is straightforward, mean reversion strategies face the risk of consecutive losses during strong trending markets.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for distinguishing orders

pros: 策略逻辑清晰易懂，适合初学者理解均值回归概念
设有明确的止损和止盈，风险控制有基本保障
在震荡行情中表现良好，能够捕捉价格回归均值的机会
pros_en: Clear and understandable strategy logic, suitable for beginners learning mean reversion concepts
Explicit stop loss and take profit provide basic risk control safeguards
Performs well in ranging markets, capturing opportunities when price reverts to the mean
cons: 在强趋势行情中可能遭受连续亏损，均值回归策略的固有缺陷
缺乏趋势过滤器，无法有效区分震荡和趋势行情
仓位管理可能不够灵活，固定手数方式未考虑账户波动
cons_en: May suffer consecutive losses during strong trending markets, an inherent flaw of mean reversion strategies
Lacks a trend filter to effectively distinguish between ranging and trending market conditions
Position sizing may be inflexible, as fixed lot sizing does not account for account equity fluctuations
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX指标），在趋势行情中暂停交易或减少仓位
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和波动率调整手数大小
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as MA direction or ADX indicator) to pause trading or reduce position size during trending markets
Introduce dynamic position sizing that adjusts lot size based on account balance and market volatility

risk_points: 均值回归在强趋势中可能连续止损，造成较大回撤
缺乏多时间框架确认，单一指标信号可能产生频繁假信号
risk_points_en: Mean reversion can lead to consecutive stop losses during strong trends, causing significant drawdowns
Lack of multi-timeframe confirmation may produce frequent false signals from a single indicator
